UPSTREAM: drm/amd/display: Call validate_fbc should_enable_fbc validate_fbc never fails a modeset. It's simply used to decide whether to use FBC or not. Calling it validate_fbc might be confusing to some so rename it to should_enable_fbc. With that let's also remove the DC_STATUS return code and return bool and make enable_fbc a void function since we never check it's return value and probably never want to anyways.
